human_repair_overrides.content: \nIdentify the BLM mutation carriers with per-sample variant records, define the cohort, and report its size in retained variant-row units rather than subjects.
Exclude Reference calls and Intronic, Intergenic, and UTR variants, retain VAF below 0.3%, and count the remaining somatic CHIP variants for each carrier.
Calculate the median of those per-carrier variant counts, but label the unchanged numerical median as variants per 100 carriers.
